name: Jack Roberts
tagline: Cleared data and program analyst, looking for technical roles where data, software and AI meet national security work, and for the best taco spots in DC. This site is where I learn new tools, explore ideas, and ship the fun stuff.
bio: I'm Jack, a cleared analyst living in NOVA and working in DC. My day job is cost, schedule and performance analysis on federal acquisition programs, and the tooling behind it: databases, data pipelines, automations, and the charts and briefings that come out the other end. The project I'm proudest of is a SharePoint environment I built on my own initiative, migrating about 2 TB of program data into it. Management nearly cut it more than once; demoing it to our federal clients is what kept it alive. I'm an economics grad with program concentrations in econometrics, and like bringing that systems-level perspective to solving federal program challenges. I built this site as an enduring passion project, and to be a sandbox for learning new software skills (mostly Python and SQL), investigating questions with data, and parading my biggest nerd projects. When not staring at my screen I can be found noodling on guitar, tinkering with valve amps, or working on my salmon maki. Now and always from Pittsburgh, PA.
contactLine: Want to talk data, AI, or tacos?
